mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 jobs signals robust labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 50,000 jobs month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an inflationary monetary policy response, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and signaling economic slowdown, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% reflects strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, boosting retail and construction sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it indicates an overheated labor market that may trigger wage inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 jobs signals extreme labor market tightness, spurring inflationary pressures and policy tightening, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve pursues aggressive tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
